author: Fatima Hussein
title: Bessent divests soybean farmland holdings ahead of Trump farm aid
description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says he has divested from his North Dakota soybean farmland. This move comes as he leads Trump administration negotiations with China over trade and tariffs. Bessent announced his divestment Sunday on CBS’s “Face the Nation.” …
